newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas firms in Q4, weaker in Q1.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas firms in Q4, weaker in Q1.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures traded in the fourth quarter of this year and first quarter 1998 in the morning session on Tuesday, with the market direction mixed.
A total of 150 lots changed hands.
One hundred lots traded in Q1, the most heavily traded quarter on Monday. January and February both shed 0.025 pence per therm to 18.675.
November climbed slightly to 13.650 p/th, while December traded at 15.70 p/th.
"There's no particular direction...people are just tying up bits and pieces," a broker said.
